title: Stratasys Brings Production-Proven Additive Manufacturing to IMTS 2026 Across Aerospace, Defense, Automotive and Healthcare Applications

# Stratasys Brings Production-Proven Additive Manufacturing to IMTS 2026 Across Aerospace, Defense, Automotive and Healthcare Applications


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_1e91e4c5372eccb9ccc11ea9caf1b700/stratasys/news/2026-09-10_Stratasys_Brings_Production_Proven_Additive_992.pdf) September 10, 2026 8:15am EDT


**Expanded portfolio and latest product introductions anchor Stratasys’ presence at the world’s largest manufacturing technology event**


MINNETONKA, Minn. & REHOVOT, Israel--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Stratasys Ltd. (NASDAQ: SSYS) today announced it will showcase production-proven additive manufacturing solutions at the International Manufacturing Technology Show (IMTS) 2026 in Chicago. During the show, from September 14 to 19, Stratasys will demonstrate solutions for manufacturers utilizing additive to solve real production, tooling and supply chain challenges.


At the center of Stratasys’ solutions is a simple message: **Made for Manufacturing. Proven in Production.** Stratasys will demonstrate how manufacturers across aerospace, defense, automotive, healthcare, industrial and other demanding sectors are using Stratasys solutions to reduce tooling costs and lead times, improve operational efficiency, increase manufacturing flexibility and strengthen supply chain resilience.


As an advanced manufacturing partner, Stratasys combines additive technologies, certified materials, production-grade hardware, software, application expertise and manufacturing services to help customers solve practical business challenges and achieve measurable results in production environments.


At the Stratasys booth, see how additive solutions are being used across tooling, fixtures, manufacturing aids, end-use parts and factory-floor applications. Attendees will find practical examples of how production-proven, Stratasys solutions improve performance, reduce costs, and accelerate innovation.


Stratasys will also highlight several recently introduced products, materials and software solutions designed to help manufacturers address application-specific requirements and improve productivity, including:


- **F870™ 3D Printer:** Stratasys’ longest heated-chamber FDM® system, featuring a 1-meter build length, integrated material drying, and support for carbon fiber-reinforced FDM® Nylon 12CF parts, enabling reliable production of strong, durable tooling, fixtures, and end-use parts. (See separate F870 release for full details.)
- **ASA Military Colors for Fortus® Systems:** Mission-specific color options for defense applications where printed parts must meet visual and regulatory requirements for fielded equipment.
- **Somos® Resolute Gray™:** A stereolithography resin for industrial and automotive parts that require stiffness, dimensional stability and a production-ready surface finish straight off the printer.
- **Additive App Suite, powered by trinckle:** Software that lets manufacturing teams design fixtures, trays, and tooling in minutes, without CAD, and print them on any 3D printer.


“Manufacturers are looking for proven solutions they can scale across production environments,” said **Rich Garrity, Chief Business Unit Officer, Stratasys** **.** “At IMTS, we’re showing the full picture: certified materials, production-grade hardware, qualified workflows and real results from manufacturers who have moved well beyond the pilot stage.”


**Learn from Stratasys Experts**


Throughout IMTS, Stratasys experts will share how manufacturers are scaling additive manufacturing in production environments, with sessions addressing aerospace and defense manufacturing, production-ready drone applications, digital manufacturing workflows, dimensional accuracy and repeatability at scale.


**Featured sessions include:**


**Drones: Full Stack Solutions for Compliant, Scalable Production Using Stratasys Additive Manufacturing** *Conrad Smith, Director, Global Aerospace* Tuesday, September 15, 3:30-4:00 PM | Room S101B


**Why Accuracy & Precision Are No Longer the Limiting Factor in Additive Manufacturing** *Michael Inbar, Sr. Applications Engineer* Wednesday, September 16, 11:00-11:55 AM | Room W192-B


**Visit Stratasys at Booth 338460 in the South Hall during IMTS 2026, September 14-19, at McCormick Place in Chicago.**


**About Stratasys**


Stratasys is leading the global shift to additive manufacturing with innovative 3D printing solutions for industries including aerospace, automotive, consumer products, and healthcare. Through smart and connected 3D printers, polymer materials, a software ecosystem, and parts on demand, Stratasys solutions deliver competitive advantages at every stage of the product value chain. The world’s leading organizations turn to Stratasys to transform product design, bring agility to manufacturing and supply chains, and improve patient care.


To learn more, visit Stratasys.com.
